description: ISO 6346 container check digit. Four letters (the fourth is U, J, Z or R), six serial digits and a check digit. Letter values skip every multiple of 11, then each value is multiplied by 2 to the power of its position. The total mod 11 mod 10 is the check digit. Spaces are ignored. This does not look the owner up at BIC. Returns JSON with: valid, compact, kind, reason, check, owner, category, serial. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/container-check
name: container_check
